name: impact-tree
description: Review Git changes in a local browser with dependency graphs, file diffs, AI summaries, and change chat.

interface.longDescription: Open a local browser view of a Git comparison to trace dependencies, read diffs and AI summaries, and ask questions about changes. Requires a local Git worktree, Python 3.9 or later, Git, and Graphify. GitHub CLI is optional for pull request selection.
defaultPrompt: Open Impact Tree for my working tree.
Open Impact Tree to compare my branch with main.
